title: AC1021 system and data page CRC independent retrace
scope: Re-run the existing test-local, bitwise ODA CRC diagnostic on one AC1021 data page and its page-map system page; compare the extracted fields with the current reader and a local open-source peer without changing parser behavior.

sample.repositoryStatus: local untracked sample; inspected in place and not added or modified

dataPage.parseResult: success; data-page CRC diagnostic remains a mismatch

pageMapSystemPage.parseResult: success; both system-page CRC diagnostics remain mismatches

normativeSource.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
normativeSource.finding: The file-header fields identify the page-map CRCs, seed and correction factor; ODA specifies mirrored CRC over the compressed-or-raw system payload and over data-page compressed/encrypted payload, with UpdateSeed1 and size-dependent inputs. The source retrace used the corresponding independently implemented bitwise CRC and seed recurrence already pinned by literal vectors.

peerCheck.result: The command read the sample and returned SUCCESS while logging unrelated warnings. The inspected R2007 read_system_page implementation decodes/decompresses the page but does not compare these 64-bit CRC fields; it is not an independent CRC oracle for this mismatch.

assessment.nextAction: Compare exact seed/field extraction and CRC inputs on a second provenance-qualified AC1021 source or a verified producer resave; do not change CRC handling unless an independently sourced payload matches the stored field under the normative profile.

correction.finding: The earlier test-local bitwise reference copied the wrong reflected polynomial and repeated the same remainder-order mistake as production. It was independent code, but not independent of those assumptions. ODA v5.4.1 table values and ordering, plus the original and ODA-resaved page checks, identify both errors. The historical mismatch values above are pre-fix observations.
